videos.why: The only ready Short. A core what-if on the continent everyone knows: frame 0 is the whole of Africa with the crack glowing, and the first line asks the title's question. Scored above rank's 5.3 because QA passed it clean after two rounds.
strengths: The title's question is the first line, over the whole map of Africa
The answer is drawn on the map: sea in the Afar, a new coast, the Horn drifting off
The payoff is a real, surprising fact: 60 km torn open in 2005 in days
risks: 21 s without a close shot in the middle
The rate is sourced from Wikipedia, a weaker source than the profile prefers
